msg: warning: Variable len is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 95755181b82.c (BusyBox httpd). Dead store on 'len' at line 36 ('len += sprintf(iobuf + len, ...)'), presence condition True. After all len assignments in send_headers(), the function only calls printf(iobuf) — len is never used after assignment — simplification artifact (real code uses len to track the header buffer position). When GZIP=false: content_gzip is undeclared (treated as 0), making line 36 unreachable, so the alarm fires spuriously in that configuration too. The known vbdb bug is the UndeclaredIdentifier on content_gzip when GZIP=false.
